_schema.SCA_NAME_PREFIX: string (required) - prefix of the supply chain actions this spec creates; a run id is appended
_schema.TYPE: string (required) - supply chain action type sent on create
_schema.UI_CONFIG: string (required) - uiConfig sent on create; planning-mfe JSON.parses it
_schema.UNKNOWN_ID: string (required) - well-formed UUID that is not a supply chain action
_schema.CLIENT_SUPPLIED_ID: string (required) - id a client sends on create, which the server must replace
_schema.CONSTRAINT_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a database constraint violation (duplicate name, missing NOT NULL column)
_schema.NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for PUT or DELETE of an unknown id
_schema.INVALID_JSON_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a malformed body
_schema.DELETE_MESSAGE: string (required) - DELETE success body; {id} is replaced with the deleted id

DELETE_MESSAGE: Supply Chain Action with id [{id}] deleted successfully.
